scenarios.prompt: Create a new Web full-stack project without prescribing a framework.
Add an API-only business flow to an existing full-stack application and reuse UI and deployment.
Classify the request and stop before Harness handoff.
Proceed to the first governed mutation and load only references required before that operation.
Compare Agent context and MCP tool routes with an ordinary REST change.
Accept equivalent explanations but reject missing fields, invalid enums, forged confirmation, incompatible protocol, and unsafe actions.

S1.cutoff: first classification reply and confirmation boundary

S2.cutoff: Harness handoff before first governed mutation

limitations: Normative full-file inputs are frozen here; actual Agent read events remain not-run until observed event input exists.
This measures Skill context volume, not a model bill or success-rate improvement.
